text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commendable! You strive toward your
dreams
together as one!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Know that I am always behind you
cheering your
efforts! Forge ever ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's apparently quite impressed with
the way
we're conducting our practice
sessions.
